summary: First GW4 pass, run on Monday evening at Justin's request, five days before the deadline and ahead of Friday's waivers, so it is the fixtures-and-form read rather than the press-conference read - every club's pre-match briefing is still to come. Two things frame the week: there is no international break (the September and October windows are merged into 21 Sept to 6 Oct), and City, Arsenal and Liverpool all play Champions League matchday one midweek. Eight of the fifteen look safe (Pickford, Raya, Gvardiol, Milenkovic, Schade, Tavernier, Marmoush, Haaland), all likely rather than start only because no fixture-specific XI exists yet. Four are genuine doubts, three of them corrections to last week's read: Bijol was dropped at Brighton behind new signing Elvedi, Munoz is still being built up to fitness behind Aina, Strand Larsen was benched for Nketiah at Fulham despite Mateta's injury, and Garner came off hurt on 77 minutes and is now flagged at 75%. Collins is out with the calf strain that ended his Saturday after 16 minutes, Doku is out with no training return reported, and Barcola stays bench after a 26-minute debut with Iraola asking for patience. Last week's verdicts, for the record: 11 of 15 right, wrong on Bijol, Munoz and Strand Larsen (all likely, all benched) and unlucky on Collins. This environment could not open the cited articles, so everything rests on search-result snippets from the permitted outlets; the scheduled research should redo the pass properly once the squad is final after Friday's waivers.
